user.title: Connect to PatchMon
user.description: Create a dedicated API token for Home Assistant in PatchMon (Settings → Integrations → Scoped Credentials) with only the `host:get` permission.

data_description.url: Address of the PatchMon web interface, for example http://192.168.1.10:3000. https addresses work as well.
data_description.token_key: The key of the API token
data_description.token_secret: The secret of the API token. PatchMon shows it only once, when the token is created.
data_description.verify_ssl: Only applies to https addresses. Turn off if the server uses a self-signed certificate.
data_description.area: New hosts and the PatchMon server are placed in this area when they are added. Devices you move later stay where you put them.

optional_entities.name: Optional entities
optional_entities.description: Enables the entity on every host. You can change this later under Configure.

data.enable_update_entity: Updates (update entity with the package list)

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the PatchMon token
reauth_confirm.description: PatchMon at {url} rejected the API token. Enter a valid token key and secret with the `host:get` permission.

data_description.token_key: The key of the API token
data_description.token_secret: The secret of the API token

data_description.url: Address of the PatchMon web interface, for example http://192.168.1.10:3000. https addresses work as well.
data_description.token_key: The key of the API token

error.ssl_error: The SSL certificate could not be verified. For a self-signed certificate, turn off certificate verification.

error.token_disabled: This API token is disabled in PatchMon.

error.ip_not_allowed: This API token is not allowed from the IP address of Home Assistant. Check the token's IP restriction in PatchMon.
error.missing_permission: This API token lacks the `host:get` permission.

error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This PatchMon server is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant reads the host list from PatchMon. This does not make the agents report more often.
data_description.host_groups: Only include hosts in these groups. Leave empty for all hosts.
data_description.area: New hosts and the PatchMon server are placed in this area when they are added. Devices you move later stay where you put them.

optional_entities.name: Optional entities

host_groups_without_hosts.title: Host group filter of {title} matches no host
host_groups_without_hosts.description: The host group filter of {title} contains groups without any host in PatchMon: {groups}. The groups were deleted or are empty. Their hosts are kept in Home Assistant but are unavailable. Open **Configure** on the integration entry and update the host group filter.
